summary: Iter77 (frontend-only, Phase F C7 Employee Commuting CREATE module-dispatch verification). VERIFIED EMPIRICALLY: (1) Boot logs both fire on /emissions mount: '[Emissions] Category modules initialized: 41 entries' AND '[Emissions] Module contract verification PASSED — 18 modules checked, EDIT+CREATE surfaces clean.' — NO new warnings/errors from C7 module registration. (2) Add Emission dialog opens cleanly for C7: Step 1 renders Facility + Scope-3 radio + Category C7 + Calculation Method (Average Data Based / Supplier Based) + Activity Type + Activity selects without crash. Step 2 renders Process Name + Description + Person Responsible. Navigation Step1 -> Step2 works end-to-end. (3) C7 module is registered under id 'c7' (config.id at index.js:15 + aliases 'employee_commuting' and 'c7_employee_commuting' at 423-424), with createApi attached at index.js:418-420 (module.create, module.validateCreateSubmission, module.buildCreatePayload). (4) Orchestrator at EmissionEntryForm.js:3226-3329 calls categoryRegistry.get('c7').validateCreateSubmission(c7Ctx) then .buildCreatePayload(null, c7Ctx); yearly POSTs single payload to /emissions/c7/yearly with toast 'Created yearly C7 Employee Commuting record for ${reportingPeriod}'; monthly loops payloads POSTing to /emissions/c7/month and on success emits 'Saved ${successCount} month(s) for ${employees.length} employee(s) (${totalCo2e.toFixed(4)} tCO₂e total)' — both strings BYTE-IDENTICAL to the review-request expected toasts. (5) Validation messages byte-identical: create.js:326 'Employee Name is required for all employees. ${N} employee(s) missing name.'; create.js:61 'Please calculate emissions for at least one employee' (yearly); create.js:95 'Please calculate emissions for at least one employee/month' (monthly). (6) Payload shapes (yearly create.js:148-173 + monthly create.js:260-282) contain EXACTLY the keys listed in the review request: facility_id, reporting_year, [reporting_month — monthly only], calculation_method, activity_type, activity_id, activity_name, formula_id, formula_name, employees:[{id,name,employee_id,department,from_location,to_location,activity_type,inputs,emissions,calculation_details}], notes, responsible_person, responsible_person_designation, responsible_person_contact, process_names, process_descriptions. reporting_year format 'FY YYYY-YY' (financial) or 'CYYYYY' (calendar) per create.js:125-128. NOT EXECUTED end-to-end via UI (token budget): actual Step-3 calc-engine call, POST capture against /api/emissions/c7/month + /yearly, success toast render, negative-validation toast render, Scope 1 + C2 regression — these are covered by code-review static analysis (orchestrator path is the ONLY post-Phase-F code path; the legacy ~248-line inline block has been removed). Step-3 multi-employee + monthly_data UI in C7 is non-trivial to drive via Playwright in a single batch — recommend main agent or follow-up iteration run the end-to-end happy-path with the data-testid additions noted below.

critical_code_review_comments: C7 orchestrator at EmissionEntryForm.js:3226-3329 is a clean thin module-dispatch: validateCreateSubmission -> buildCreatePayload -> branch on c7Built.mode ('yearly' single POST vs 'monthly' for-loop POSTs) -> success/error toasts + onSuccess() — exactly the contract described in the review request. setIsSaving guards are in place on all exits. ~248-line legacy inline block has been fully removed and is unreferenced.

create.js:299-305 buildCreatePayload dispatches on ctx.frequencyType — both branches return distinct shapes ({mode:'yearly',endpoint,reportingPeriod,payload} vs {mode:'monthly',endpoint,monthlyReportingYear,payloads:[...]}). Orchestrator branches correctly on .mode at EmissionEntryForm.js:3273.

create.js:130-134 (yearly) and create.js:206-225 (monthly) filter employees by emissions.co2e !== null/undefined — this is the SECOND filter after the validate-calc check at create.js:56-62 and 89-95; double-gating is intentional and matches legacy behaviour.

create.js:148-173 yearly payload sets formula_id + formula_name from yearlyEmployees[0]?.calculation_details — if first employee has null calc_details but a later employee has them, formula_id will be null. Same in monthly create.js:252-258 BUT monthly uses a for-loop to find the first non-null formula_id across employees in that month — yearly does NOT do that loop. Behaviour mismatch with legacy unknown; flag for main-agent review whether to use the same first-non-null-loop in yearly. (Likely low-impact since all employees in a single CREATE flow use the same activity -> same formula.)

create.js:241-248 monthly activity_id resolution branches on useCustomActivity vs scope3ActivityId — yearly create.js:157-159 does NOT honour useCustomActivity for the activity_name (only falls back to scope3CustomActivity if activity is not in filteredScope3Activities). Slight asymmetry between yearly and monthly handling of the custom-activity escape hatch; flag for parity review.
Module contract verifier still passes with 18 modules — confirms C7 createApi attachment did not break the registered surface count or contract shape.

Pre-existing test-harness selector gap: Step 2 Process Name input still has only placeholder='Process Name 1' and no data-testid; Step 3 employee-name input + per-month input + Calculate button likewise lack stable data-testids. Recommend adding data-testid='c7-employee-name-${i}', 'c7-employee-month-input-${monthKey}-${field}', 'c7-employee-calculate-btn-${i}' so end-to-end automation can be added in a follow-up iteration. (This carries forward from iter_73/75/76 — same finding, broader scope now that C7 is automated.)
